grandparents_cupboard.reason: Apples, orange, butter, flour, sugar, almonds, cinnamon and Greek yoghurt are all ordinary home kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including Bramleys and flaked almonds, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a bowl and a grater, and rubbing in is beginner technique.

works.reason: The standard crumble proportions and 35 minutes at 200°C will soften four Bramleys under a golden topping, though the filling will be on the tart side.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and slicing four apples, zesting and rubbing in fit in 15 minutes, and the 35-minute bake matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the cinnamon and yoghurt, is used, and flaked almonds are a fair label for the almonds id.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm Bramley crumble suits a chilly early March afternoon, and the apples are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps read plainly in British English and are easy for a beginner to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: A fruit-heavy crumble with almonds and yoghurt is real food that a family would happily eat again.
